name: Release artifact tampering via Meson custom_target injection
description: Meson-adapted version of the package_release mutant. Models release artifact tampering (similar to ASUS Live Update / ShadowHammer) by injecting a custom_target into meson.build that executes a payload during the normal compile step, dropping a marker file upon execution.

placeholders.MESON_BUILD: path to the root meson.build file

template.replacement_value:
# Injected supply chain mutation operator hook
custom_target('supply_chain_payload',
  output: 'supply_chain_payload.stamp',
  command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo pwned > "$0"/PWNED_release_customtarget_{{MARKER_ID}} && touch @OUTPUT@', meson.project_source_root()],
  build_by_default: true)

preconditions: project uses the Meson build system
the attacker can modify or inject hooks into the project's meson.build file
the release workflow executes `meson compile` (or `ninja`) to produce build artifacts
